auth.label: Personal Access Token
auth.description: Create a personal access token at app.teable.cn/setting/personal-access-token and paste it here.

actions.name: create_records
actions.description: Create one or more records in a Teable table using provider-defined field values.

tableId.description: The ID of the Teable table where records should be created.

additionalProperties.description: A Teable cell value using the field's documented value shape.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

fieldKeyType.description: The key type used for record fields in the request or response.

typecast.description: Whether Teable should automatically convert supplied values to each field's data type.

inputSchema.description: Input for creating records in a Teable table.

additionalProperties.description: A Teable cell value using the field's documented value shape.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

name.description: The primary field value rendered as text.

autoNumber.description: The table-wide auto number assigned to the record.

createdTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was created.

lastModifiedTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was last modified.

createdBy.description: The name of the user who created the record.

lastModifiedBy.description: The name of the user who last modified the record.

undeletable.description: Whether Teable prevents this record from being deleted.

items.description: A Teable record. Provider-added fields are preserved.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Permanently delete one Teable record by table ID and record ID.

tableId.description: The ID of the Teable table containing the record.

recordId.description: The ID of the Teable record to permanently delete.

inputSchema.description: Input for permanently deleting a Teable record.

deleted.description: Whether Teable accepted the delete request.

recordId.description: The ID of the deleted Teable record.

outputSchema.description: The connector's acknowledgement of the Teable delete operation.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Get the Teable user associated with the connected personal access token.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to get the current Teable user.

anyOf.description: The user's avatar URL, when configured.

avatar.description: The user's avatar URL, when configured.

email.description: The user's email address, when returned by Teable.

outputSchema.description: The Teable user associated with the connected token.

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Get one Teable record by table ID and record ID.

tableId.description: The ID of the Teable table containing the record.

recordId.description: The ID of the Teable record to retrieve.

items.description: A field name, field ID, or database field name.

projection.description: The field names or IDs to include, interpreted according to fieldKeyType.

cellFormat.description: The format used for record cell values.

fieldKeyType.description: The key type used for record fields in the request or response.

inputSchema.description: Input for getting a single Teable record.

additionalProperties.description: A Teable cell value using the field's documented value shape.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

name.description: The primary field value rendered as text.

autoNumber.description: The table-wide auto number assigned to the record.

createdTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was created.

lastModifiedTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was last modified.

createdBy.description: The name of the user who created the record.

lastModifiedBy.description: The name of the user who last modified the record.

undeletable.description: Whether Teable prevents this record from being deleted.

record.description: A Teable record. Provider-added fields are preserved.

actions.name: list_bases
actions.description: List the Teable bases in a space accessible to the connected token.

spaceId.description: The ID of the Teable space whose bases should be listed.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing Teable bases in a space.

name.description: The display name of the base.

spaceId.description: The ID of the space containing the base.

role.description: The current user's role in the base.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user who created the base.

items.description: A Teable base. Provider-added fields are preserved.

bases.description: The Teable bases returned for the space.

outputSchema.description: Bases in the requested Teable space.

actions.name: list_records
actions.description: List records in a Teable table with optional projection, view, filtering, sorting, and offset pagination.

tableId.description: The ID of the Teable table whose records should be listed.

items.description: A field name, field ID, or database field name.

projection.description: The field names or IDs to include, interpreted according to fieldKeyType.

cellFormat.description: The format used for record cell values.

fieldKeyType.description: The key type used for record fields in the request or response.

viewId.description: The view whose filters and sorting should be applied.

ignoreViewQuery.description: Whether to ignore the selected view's filter and sorting configuration.

conjunction.description: How the filter entries are combined.

items.description: A Teable field condition or nested filter group.

filterSet.description: The field conditions or nested filter groups to apply.

filter.description: A Teable filter object containing field conditions or nested filter groups.

fieldId.description: The ID of the field used for sorting.

order.description: The direction used to sort the field.

orderBy.description: The Teable sort definitions applied in priority order.

take.description: The maximum number of records to return, up to 1000.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before returning results.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing records from a Teable table.

additionalProperties.description: A Teable cell value using the field's documented value shape.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

name.description: The primary field value rendered as text.

autoNumber.description: The table-wide auto number assigned to the record.

createdTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was created.

lastModifiedTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was last modified.

createdBy.description: The name of the user who created the record.

lastModifiedBy.description: The name of the user who last modified the record.

undeletable.description: Whether Teable prevents this record from being deleted.

items.description: A Teable record. Provider-added fields are preserved.

records.description: The Teable records returned by the query.

outputSchema.description: Records returned by Teable and optional provider-defined query metadata.

actions.name: list_spaces
actions.description: List the Teable spaces accessible to the connected personal access token.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to list accessible Teable spaces.

name.description: The display name of the space.

role.description: The current user's role in the space.

organization.description: The organization associated with the space, when present.

items.description: A Teable space. Provider-added fields are preserved.

outputSchema.description: Spaces accessible to the connected Teable token.

actions.name: list_tables
actions.description: List the Teable tables in a base accessible to the connected token.

baseId.description: The ID of the Teable base whose tables should be listed.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing Teable tables in a base.

name.description: The display name of the table.

dbTableName.description: The physical database table name managed by Teable.

icon.description: The emoji icon configured for the table.

order.description: The table's display order within the base.

lastModifiedTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the table was last modified.

defaultViewId.description: The ID of the table's default view.

items.description: A Teable table. Provider-added fields are preserved.

tables.description: The Teable tables returned for the base.

outputSchema.description: Tables in the requested Teable base.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

fieldKeyType.description: The key type used for record fields in the request or response.

typecast.description: Whether Teable should automatically convert supplied values to each field's data type.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Teable field name, field ID, or database field name.

name.description: The primary field value rendered as text.

autoNumber.description: The table-wide auto number assigned to the record.

createdTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was created.

lastModifiedTime.description: The ISO 8601 time when the record was last modified.

createdBy.description: The name of the user who created the record.
